# ZetsApp

> ZetsApp builds and sells custom software, AI solutions, and ready-to-use SaaS products for startups and enterprises. We also publish in-depth engineering guides and host a directory of business software with pricing, features, and reviews.

ZetsApp helps businesses **build**, **buy**, and **compare** software:
- Custom software development (web & mobile apps)
- AI & machine learning services (LLM apps, AI agents, RAG pipelines)
- AI automation for business workflows and processes
- SaaS products ready to adopt today
- A searchable directory of business software (CRM, HR, security, AI, collaboration, and more)

## Services
- [All Services](https://www.zetsapp.com/services): Overview of every ZetsApp development service.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke software built around unique business workflows.
- [AI Development Services](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/ai-development): LLM apps, AI agents, RAG pipelines, and machine learning.
- [AI Automation Services](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/ai-automation): Workflow automation, AI agents, and business process automation.
- [Web App Development](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/web-app-development): Fast, SEO-friendly web applications.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps.
- [SaaS Products](https://www.zetsapp.com/services/saas-products): Ready-to-deploy business software.
- [Contact / Hire Us](https://www.zetsapp.com/home/contact): Start a project or request a quote.
